ov: توتسي (الإنجليزية: Tootsie) هو فيلم كوميدي تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة سنة 1982 . الفيلم من إخراج سدني بولاك ، وهذا الفيلم من بطولة داستين هوفمان وجيسيكا لانج وتري غار ودابني كوليمان.
plotEn:
Michael Dorsey is a talented but difficult New York City actor whose perfectionism has left him unemployed. He supports himself by waiting tables and teaching acting classes. After learning that his friend and student Sandy Lester has unsuccessfully auditioned for the role of hospital administrator Emily Kimberly on the daytime soap opera Southwest General, Michael disguises himself as a woman named Dorothy Michaels and wins the part. He hopes to earn $8,000 to finance a play by his roommate, Jeff Slater, in which he and Sandy will star.
As Dorothy, Michael transforms Emily Kimberly into an outspoken feminist, frequently improvising dialogue and challenging the show's scripts. His unconventional performance makes Dorothy a national sensation. Michael's double life soon becomes complicated. When Sandy catches him trying on her clothes, he conceals his deception by claiming he wants to sleep with her. They begin a sexual relationship, although Michael is increasingly attracted to his co-star Julie Nichols, a single mother involved with the show's sexist director, Ron Carlisle.
After Julie confides in Dorothy about her romantic frustrations, Michael approaches her at a party using a pickup line she had suggested would work on her. Julie responds by throwing a drink in his face. Later, having ended her relationship with Ron on Dorothy's advice, Julie gently rebuffs an apparent romantic advance from Dorothy, explaining that she is heterosexual.
